source_statement: Triangle ABC has a right angle at C, and D is the foot of the altitude from C to AB. Points L, M , and N are the midpoints of segments AD, DC, and CA, respectively. If CL = 7 and BM = 12, compute BN 2 .

clause_ledger.source: triangle ABC has a right angle at C
D is the foot of the altitude from C to AB
clause_ledger.dsl: D is the orthogonal projection of C onto line AB, written in the chosen coordinate gauge as the equivalent projection formula

clause_ledger.source: L, M, N are midpoints of AD, DC, CA

clause_ledger.dsl: square of the direct distance expression
